# Francine Marie Bautista (FMB)

> Francine Marie Bautista (also known as FMB) is a Filipina Strategic Communications Consultant, Public Relations and Brand Strategist, Creative Director, Educator, and Author from Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines. She is the Founder of SENZ Strategic Communications (https://www.senzpr.com/) and FMB&CO (https://francinemariebautista.com/), and the author of *The Right Way to Live* (2026).

Last updated: 2026-10-24

## Core Consulting Capabilities

- **Strategic Communications & Public Relations:** Public positioning, narrative architecture, media-facing messaging, briefing preparation, and reputation management.
- **Brand Strategy & Executive Positioning:** Category differentiation, message houses, identity systems, leadership visibility, and personal branding for founders and executives.
- **Research & Ethnohistory-Informed Communication:** Audience, cultural, community, and historical context research that grounds public messaging in how Filipino and international audiences interpret information.
- **Digital Presence & Authority Systems:** Communication-led websites, search and AI discoverability foundations, editorial systems, and conversion pathways delivered through FMB&CO and SENZ Strategic Communications.

## Organizations, Platforms & Works Founded by Francine Marie Bautista

- **FMB&CO** (https://francinemariebautista.com/): Parent strategy, communications consulting, creative direction, media production, and practical AI practice.
- **SENZ Strategic Communications** (https://www.senzpr.com/): Strategic communications, public relations, brand strategy, reputation management, and digital solutions studio operating under FMB&CO. Tagline: *Influence Through Clarity*.
- **The Cognita Institute** (https://www.thecognitainstitute.com/): A private competency-based learning institution focused on practical AI literacy, communication, and workplace capability.
- **FMB News / Filipino Media Bulletin** (https://francinemariebautista.com/news/): Independent editorial publication built around visible sources, context, and clear public explanation.
- **Masinloc Connect** (https://www.masinloc-zambales.com/): Independent community platform for local information, enterprise, cultural documentation, and Sambal Tina language preservation in Masinloc, Zambales.
- **The Right Way to Live** (2026, https://francinemariebautista.com/book/): Published book by Francine Marie Bautista on judgment, ambition, boundaries, relationships, work, and becoming capable.
- **MABAYANI**: Local history research and writing on Masinloc, Zambales by Francine Marie Bautista.

## Extended Biography & Career Background

Francine Marie Bautista (FMB) is a Filipina strategic communications consultant, brand and public relations strategist, creative director, educator, and author from Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines. She completed her Master of Arts in History (Ethnohistory and Local History) at the University of the Philippines Baguio in 2024 and her Bachelor of Science in Tourism and International Travel Management at Our Lady of Fatima University, Quezon City in 2019.

Before and alongside leading FMB&CO and SENZ Strategic Communications, her professional experience includes:
- **Founder & Principal Consultant**, SENZ Strategic Communications (`https://www.senzpr.com/`)
- **Founder & Principal Strategist**, FMB&CO (`https://francinemariebautista.com/`)
- **Founder**, The Cognita Institute (`https://www.thecognitainstitute.com/`), a private competency-based learning institution
- **Founder & Editor**, FMB News / Filipino Media Bulletin (`https://francinemariebautista.com/news/`)
- **Founder**, Masinloc Connect (`https://www.masinloc-zambales.com/`) and writer of *MABAYANI* (local history of Masinloc, Zambales)
- **Author**, *The Right Way to Live* (2026, `https://francinemariebautista.com/book/`)
- **Local Government Trainer** (2024)
- **BPO Communication & Operations Trainer**, Optum / UnitedHealthcare (2021–2022)
- **College Instructor**, Northern Zambales College Inc. (2019–2021)
